per_hop.query:
SELECT host.name, COUNT(show.id) AS number_of_shows
FROM appearances AS ap
JOIN tv_show AS show ON ap.show_id = show.id
JOIN host ON show.host_id = host.id
WHERE ap.performer = 'Paul Melba'
  AND show.country = 'UK'
GROUP BY host.name
HAVING COUNT(show.id) = 23;
